description: This PHP source file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Struct, which represents an XML-RPC struct value in the Zend Framework. It extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection and includes methods for constructing the struct and generating its XML representation.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Struct
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC struct value, providing methods for construction and XML generation.
